statement.title: The case $\operatorname{rank}E=2$
statement.full_tex: In Case~2b of the proof of Lemma~\ref{app:return-balanced}: for $\ell=z$ and the correction $h=WX_sW^\dagger$, the monomial gate $Z_1h$, in the basis $\ket\pm\otimes\ket x$, has a permutation of cycle type $2^26^2$, so this case does not occur. For $\ell=s$, the Pauli-MASA condition on the off-diagonal block makes every $\operatorname{diag}\theta_t$ Clifford, and among the $64$ choices of $a,b,c,d,e,f\in\F_2$ the three unipotence conditions hold exactly when $a=b=c=e=0$ and $d=f$.

finite_domain: The permutation of Z_1 h on 16 points; the 512 two-target phase tables; the 64 parameter choices a, b, c, d, e, f.

covered_subclaims: Z_1 h has cycle type 2^2 6^2; every stationary phase table is Clifford; the unipotence conditions hold exactly when a = b = c = e = 0 and d = f, and then a common witness exists.

remaining_work: No verifier of supplied evidence separate from the recomputation.

checker_conventions: paper/conventions.json; each checker states its coordinate order in its docstring
